values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 5 pm on the day of arrival, online or 1-800-456-2267. 'Walk-ins will not be permitted' at DEC campgrounds. Reservations need at least 2 nights until DEC's season opens (May 8 in 2026, when its first campgrounds open): 'When the first campground opens for the season, the reservation minimums at all facilities will become 1 night until closing.' A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

Walk-ins will not be permitted'; 'up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 nights'; CHECK-IN TIME) + https://dec.ny.gov/sites/default/files/2025-04/summerreccampgroundsummary.pdf (Devil's Tombstone RES MIN 2), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DEC lists 24 sites; ReserveAmerica sells 23 drive-in sites: 1 pull-through and 4 back-in at 40 ft, 6 at 30 ft, 12 at 20 ft. Wooded sites in Stony Clove by small, shallow Notch Lake.

note: DEC (Catskill), Hunter; tight mountain access (smaller rigs advised). Trailheads to Hunter Mountain, Indian Head and the West Kill Range. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $16 + $5 non-resident and the 2-night pre-season minimum (DEC 2026 summary), phone, no electric, 2027 season May 14 - Oct 11 (matches). NEW: 9-month window, same-day until 5 pm with no walk-ins, 14-night max (were inherited); 24 sites, max 40 ft incl. a pull-through (11 of 23 drive-in sites take 30-40 ft, so a 23-ft rig fits); vault toilets, water spigots, carry-in/carry-out. Note: dropped site/hookup/length/booking restatements, the 'RV Life unrated' line and the MINIMUM STAY line (booking.min_stay holds it).
